issues.message: source has both 'table' and 'manual': a source is a catalog table or entered by hand, not both
binding has both 'variable' and 'manual': a column is a catalog variable or entered by hand, not both
source needs 'table' (a catalog table) or 'manual' (data the catalog does not document, entered by hand)
binding needs 'variable' (a catalog variable) or 'manual' (a column the catalog does not document, entered by hand)
a source entered by hand holds only columns entered by hand: a catalog variable needs a source with its 'table'
